institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
technology_type: Process Technology, Ready to prepare food, Functional Food
problem_solved: Need for ready to prepare functional foods from traditional grains to aid in the prevention and management of lifestyle-associated diseases.
description: Processes for the development of traditional millet-based and indigenous vegetable-based ready-to-prepare products, including soup mix, porridge, and upma. Traditional grains are sprouted, dehydrated, milled, and formulated into a variety of products that can be used as functional food for potential health benefits.
applications: Manufacturing of commercial functional breakfast mixes ,Production of ready-to-prepare therapeutic soup formulas , Processing of specialized geriatric and pediatric nutrition products ,Formulation of value-added traditional grain snacks
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, MedTech & Health Care, Consumer & Lifestyle Products, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
